name: OffsetLine
formula: =LAMBDA(xi,yi,xj,yj,oLen,LET(desc, "This is an Offset Function", dist_ij, SQRT((xj - xi) ^ 2 + (yj - yi) ^ 2), pt_1, OffsetPoint(xi, yi, xj, yj, 0, oLen), pt_2, OffsetPoint(xi, yi, xj, yj, dist_ij, oLen), HSTACK(pt_1, pt_2)))
comment: This function offset a line. Input: 2 pts, offset length. Output: new point
